# Part 8: Serum NfL correlates [EXPLORATORY]

## 8.1 Settings

```{r nfl-settings}
NFL <- list(
  tissues        = c("CSF", "PBMC"),
  min_donors     = 5,
  q_supported    = 0.10,
  p_exploratory  = 0.05,
  top_n          = 6,
  resume         = TRUE,
  seed           = 1)
NFL_SCORE_SETS <- lapply(list(
  hypothesis = c("SREBP2_TARGETS_CORE", "LXR_TARGETS", "OXYSTEROL_METABOLISM",
                 "HALLMARK_INTERFERON_GAMMA_RESPONSE", "HALLMARK_TNFA_SIGNALING_VIA_NFKB",
                 "MHCII_ANTIGEN_PRESENTATION", "NLRP3_INFLAMMASOME", "VLCFA_PEROXISOME",
                 "LAM_CORE", "PHAGOCYTOSIS_EFFEROCYTOSIS"),
  confound   = c("GC_RESPONSE_CANONICAL", "GC_RESPONSE_MYELOID"),
  control    = c("HALLMARK_OXIDATIVE_PHOSPHORYLATION", "IEG_DISSOCIATION_STRESS")), gs_current_names)
NFL_SOURCES <- list(
  myeloid = list(file = "05_myeloidCells_filtered_xALD.qs", label = "celltype_mc", level_all = "all_myeloid"),
  tcells  = list(file = "07_t_cells_filtered_xALD.qs",      label = "celltype",    level_all = "all_T"),
  B       = list(file = "08R_bnk_cells_annotated_xALD.qs",   label = "celltype",    level_all = "all_B",  bnk = "B"),
  NK      = list(file = "08R_bnk_cells_annotated_xALD.qs",   label = "celltype",    level_all = "all_NK", bnk = "NK"))
deg_contrast_labels$nfl              <- "serum NfL (log10)"
deg_contrast_labels$nfl_within_stage <- "serum NfL (log10), adjusted for stage"
dir.create(path$tables_nfl, recursive = TRUE, showWarnings = FALSE)
dir.create(path$graphs_nfl, recursive = TRUE, showWarnings = FALSE)
set.seed(NFL$seed)
```

## 8.2 Donors and objects

```{r nfl-data}
yn <- function(x) ifelse(is.na(x), NA, tolower(as.character(x)) %in% c("yes", "y", "true", "1"))
nfl_ids <- CLIN_SEVERITY$patient_ID[is.finite(CLIN_SEVERITY$serum_nfl)]

nfl_read <- function(src) {
  x <- qs::qread(file.path(path$objects, src$file))
  objs <- if (is.null(src$bnk)) x[intersect(NFL$tissues, names(x))] else
    stats::setNames(x[paste0(src$bnk, "_", NFL$tissues)], NFL$tissues)
  objs <- Filter(Negate(is.null), lapply(objs, function(so) {
    if (is.null(so)) return(NULL)
    if (inherits(so[["RNA"]], "Assay5")) so[["RNA"]] <- JoinLayers(so[["RNA"]])
    so <- add_severity(so, quiet = TRUE)
    keep <- as.character(so$patient_ID) %in% nfl_ids
    if (!any(keep)) NULL else so[, keep]
  }))
  objs
}
nfl_objs <- lapply(NFL_SOURCES, nfl_read)

nfl_donors <- dplyr::bind_rows(lapply(unlist(nfl_objs, recursive = FALSE), function(so) {
  md <- so@meta.data
  data.frame(donor = as.character(md$patient_ID),
             hc  = if ("Hydrocortisone" %in% names(md)) as.character(md$Hydrocortisone) else NA,
             age = if ("age" %in% names(md)) as.character(md$age) else NA)
})) %>% dplyr::distinct() %>%
  dplyr::group_by(donor) %>% dplyr::summarise(hc = dplyr::first(stats::na.omit(hc)),
                                              age = dplyr::first(stats::na.omit(age)), .groups = "drop") %>%
  dplyr::right_join(dplyr::filter(CLIN_SEVERITY, patient_ID %in% nfl_ids) %>%
                      dplyr::select(donor = patient_ID, severity, serum_nfl), by = "donor") %>%
  dplyr::mutate(hc = yn(hc), age = suppressWarnings(as.numeric(gsub(",", ".", age))),
                nfl_log10 = log10(serum_nfl),
                stage = factor(paste0("sev", severity), levels = paste0("sev", 0:3))) %>%
  dplyr::arrange(serum_nfl)
kable_save(nfl_donors, "nfl_donors", dir = path$tables_nfl, digits = 3,
           caption = "Donors with serum NfL: stage, hydrocortisone, age")
print(knitr::kable(nfl_donors, digits = 2))

rng <- nfl_donors %>% dplyr::group_by(stage) %>%
  dplyr::summarise(lo = min(serum_nfl), hi = max(serum_nfl), n = dplyr::n(), .groups = "drop")
print(rng)
nfl_separates <- nrow(rng) == 2 && (rng$hi[1] < rng$lo[2] || rng$hi[2] < rng$lo[1])
message("NfL ", if (isTRUE(nfl_separates)) "SEPARATES the stages completely" else "overlaps between stages",
        "; Spearman NfL ~ age: ",
        round(suppressWarnings(stats::cor(nfl_donors$nfl_log10, nfl_donors$age, method = "spearman",
                                          use = "complete.obs")), 2))
```

## 8.3 Functions

```{r nfl-functions}
nfl_runner <- function(so, donor_col = "patient_ID", min_cells = DEG_MIN_CELLS_PER_SAMPLE) {
  out <- list(nfl = NULL, nfl_within_stage = NULL)
  pb <- tryCatch(make_pseudobulk(so, donor_col, min_cells = min_cells), error = function(e) conditionMessage(e))
  if (is.character(pb)) return(lapply(out, function(x) pb))
  sm <- pb$meta
  i  <- match(sm[[donor_col]], nfl_donors$donor)
  sm$nfl_log10 <- nfl_donors$nfl_log10[i]
  sm$stage     <- droplevels(nfl_donors$stage[i])
  sm <- sm[is.finite(sm$nfl_log10), , drop = FALSE]
  if (nrow(sm) < NFL$min_donors)
    return(lapply(out, function(x) sprintf("fewer than %d donors with NfL (n=%d)", NFL$min_donors, nrow(sm))))
  sm$nfl_c <- sm$nfl_log10 - mean(sm$nfl_log10)
  cnt <- pb$counts[, rownames(sm), drop = FALSE]
  out$nfl <- tryCatch(get_res(fit_dds(cnt, sm, ~ nfl_c), list("nfl_c")),
                      error = function(e) trimws(conditionMessage(e)))
  n_st <- table(sm$stage)
  out$nfl_within_stage <- if (length(n_st) < 2 || any(n_st < 2)) "needs >= 2 donors in each of 2 stages" else
    tryCatch(get_res(fit_dds(cnt, sm, ~ stage + nfl_c), list("nfl_c")),
             error = function(e) trimws(conditionMessage(e)))
  out
}

NFL_PERM <- new.env()
nfl_perms <- function(n) {
  k <- as.character(n)
  if (!is.null(NFL_PERM[[k]])) return(NFL_PERM[[k]])
  p <- if (n == 1) matrix(1L, 1, 1) else {
    q <- nfl_perms(n - 1)
    do.call(rbind, lapply(seq_len(n), function(i) cbind(i, q + (q >= i))))
  }
  storage.mode(p) <- "integer"; NFL_PERM[[k]] <- p; p
}
nfl_perms_within <- function(strata) {
  idx <- split(seq_along(strata), as.character(strata))
  per <- lapply(idx, function(ix) { p <- nfl_perms(length(ix)); matrix(ix[p], nrow = nrow(p)) })
  grid <- expand.grid(lapply(per, function(p) seq_len(nrow(p))))
  out <- matrix(0L, nrow(grid), length(strata))
  for (s in seq_along(per)) out[, idx[[s]]] <- per[[s]][grid[[s]], , drop = FALSE]
  out
}
nfl_spearman <- function(Y, x, P) {
  ry <- t(apply(Y, 1, rank)); rx <- rank(x)
  X  <- matrix(rx[P], nrow = nrow(P))
  null <- suppressWarnings(stats::cor(t(X), t(ry)))
  obs  <- suppressWarnings(drop(stats::cor(rx, t(ry))))
  p <- vapply(seq_along(obs), function(k) if (!is.finite(obs[k])) NA_real_ else
    mean(abs(null[, k]) >= abs(obs[k]) - 1e-10, na.rm = TRUE), numeric(1))
  list(rho = obs, p = p, n_perm = nrow(P))
}
nfl_tier <- function(q, p) dplyr::case_when(
  is.finite(q) & q < NFL$q_supported   ~ "supported",
  is.finite(p) & p < NFL$p_exploratory ~ "exploratory",
  TRUE                                 ~ "no evidence at this sample size")
nfl_short <- function(x) sub("^BIO-", "", x)
```

## 8.4 DEG along serum NfL

```{r nfl-deg}
nfl_units <- unlist(lapply(names(NFL_SOURCES), function(cp) {
  src <- NFL_SOURCES[[cp]]; objs <- nfl_objs[[cp]]
  if (!length(objs)) return(list())
  u <- deg_loo_units(objs, NFL$tissues, src$level_all, src$label)
  if (!is.null(src$bnk)) u <- lapply(u, function(x) { if (x$level == "celltype") x$level <- paste0("celltype_", src$bnk); x })
  lapply(u, function(x) c(x, compartment = cp))
}), recursive = FALSE)
message(length(nfl_units), " DEG families")

nfl_deg_ckpt <- file.path(path$objects, "nfl", "nfl_deg.qs")
dir.create(dirname(nfl_deg_ckpt), recursive = TRUE, showWarnings = FALSE)
if (isTRUE(NFL$resume) && file.exists(nfl_deg_ckpt)) {
  deg_nfl <- qs::qread(nfl_deg_ckpt)
} else {
  deg_nfl <- dplyr::bind_rows(lapply(nfl_units, function(u) {
    message("NfL DEG | ", u$tissue, " | ", u$level, " | ", u$subset)
    flatten_contrasts(nfl_runner(u$get()), u$tissue, u$level, u$subset)
  }))
  qs::qsave(deg_nfl, nfl_deg_ckpt)
}
deg_nfl <- collect_deg_results(deg_nfl, csv_prefix = file.path(path$tables_nfl, "DEG_nfl"))
deg_nfl %>% dplyr::filter(status == "ok") %>%
  dplyr::group_by(tissue, level, subset, comparison) %>%
  dplyr::summarise(genes = dplyr::n(),
                   significant = sum(deg_is_sig(padj, log2FC) & !gene_class %in% DEG_MASK_CLASSES), .groups = "drop") %>%
  dplyr::arrange(comparison, dplyr::desc(significant)) %>%
  knitr::kable(caption = "Significant genes per family (padj < 0.05)")
```

## 8.7 Donor set scores: exact rank tests

```{r nfl-scores}
nfl_role <- stats::setNames(rep(names(NFL_SCORE_SETS), lengths(NFL_SCORE_SETS)), unlist(NFL_SCORE_SETS))
score_sets <- gs_nfl$sets[intersect(names(nfl_role), names(gs_nfl$sets))]
nfl_scores <- dplyr::bind_rows(lapply(names(NFL_SOURCES), function(cp) {
  objs <- nfl_objs[[cp]]; if (!length(objs)) return(NULL)
  gs_donor_scores(objs, score_sets, NFL_SOURCES[[cp]]$label, min_donors = NFL$min_donors) %>%
    dplyr::mutate(compartment = cp, .before = 1)
}))
readr::write_csv(nfl_scores, file.path(path$tables_nfl, "nfl_donor_scores.csv"))

nfl_score_tests <- nfl_scores %>%
  dplyr::group_by(compartment, tissue, celltype) %>%
  dplyr::group_modify(function(d, key) {
    Y <- tidyr::pivot_wider(d, id_cols = set, names_from = donor, values_from = score)
    sets <- Y$set; Y <- as.matrix(Y[, -1, drop = FALSE]); rownames(Y) <- sets
    Y <- Y[, colSums(is.na(Y)) == 0, drop = FALSE]
    dn <- colnames(Y); dd <- nfl_donors[match(dn, nfl_donors$donor), ]
    if (length(dn) < NFL$min_donors) return(tibble::tibble())
    x  <- dd$nfl_log10
    ex <- nfl_spearman(Y, x, nfl_perms(length(x)))
    ws <- if (length(unique(dd$stage)) > 1) nfl_spearman(Y, x, nfl_perms_within(dd$stage)) else NULL
    loo <- vapply(seq_along(x), function(j)
      as.numeric(suppressWarnings(stats::cor(rank(x[-j]), apply(Y[, -j, drop = FALSE], 1, rank)))),
      numeric(nrow(Y)))
    loo <- matrix(loo, nrow = nrow(Y))
    tibble::tibble(set = sets, role = unname(nfl_role[sets]), n_donors = length(dn),
                   rho = ex$rho, p_exact = ex$p, n_perm = ex$n_perm,
                   p_within_stage = if (is.null(ws)) NA_real_ else ws$p,
                   n_perm_within = if (is.null(ws)) NA_integer_ else ws$n_perm,
                   loo_rho_min = apply(loo, 1, min, na.rm = TRUE), loo_rho_max = apply(loo, 1, max, na.rm = TRUE),
                   loo_sign_flip = sign(loo_rho_min) != sign(rho) | sign(loo_rho_max) != sign(rho))
  }) %>% dplyr::ungroup() %>%
  dplyr::group_by(compartment, tissue, celltype, role) %>%
  dplyr::mutate(q = stats::p.adjust(p_exact, "BH")) %>% dplyr::ungroup() %>%
  dplyr::mutate(tier = nfl_tier(q, p_exact)) %>%
  dplyr::arrange(role != "hypothesis", p_exact)
kable_save(nfl_score_tests, "nfl_score_tests", dir = path$tables_nfl, digits = 4,
           caption = "Donor set scores vs log10 serum NfL: Spearman, exact and within-stage permutation p")
print(knitr::kable(utils::head(dplyr::filter(nfl_score_tests, role == "hypothesis"), 15), digits = 3))
```

## 8.8 Concordance with the severity contrasts

```{r nfl-concordance}
sev_tabs <- c(myeloid = "DEG_myeloid_all_genes.csv", tcells = "DEG_tcells_all_genes.csv")
nfl_conc <- dplyr::bind_rows(lapply(names(sev_tabs), function(cp) {
  f <- file.path(path$tables, sev_tabs[[cp]])
  if (!file.exists(f)) { message("not found (run Part ", if (cp == "myeloid") 3 else 4, "): ", f); return(NULL) }
  sev <- readr::read_csv(f, show_col_types = FALSE) %>%
    dplyr::filter(status == "ok", comparison %in% c("sev3_vs_sev12", "sev3_vs_sev2")) %>%
    dplyr::select(tissue, level, subset, comparison, gene, lfc_sev = log2FC_MLE, padj_sev = padj)
  nf <- deg_nfl %>% dplyr::filter(status == "ok", comparison == "nfl") %>%
    dplyr::select(tissue, level, subset, gene, lfc_nfl = log2FC_MLE, padj_nfl = padj)
  dplyr::inner_join(nf, sev, by = c("tissue", "level", "subset", "gene")) %>%
    dplyr::group_by(tissue, level, subset, comparison) %>%
    dplyr::summarise(genes = dplyr::n(),
                     rho_lfc = suppressWarnings(stats::cor(lfc_nfl, lfc_sev, method = "spearman", use = "complete.obs")),
                     sig_nfl = sum(padj_nfl < 0.05, na.rm = TRUE), sig_sev = sum(padj_sev < 0.05, na.rm = TRUE),
                     sig_both_same_dir = sum(padj_nfl < 0.05 & padj_sev < 0.05 & sign(lfc_nfl) == sign(lfc_sev), na.rm = TRUE),
                     .groups = "drop") %>%
    dplyr::mutate(compartment = cp, .before = 1)
}))
if (nrow(nfl_conc)) kable_save(nfl_conc, "nfl_concordance_severity", dir = path$tables_nfl, digits = 3,
                               caption = "NfL slope vs severity contrast (log2FC, across genes), per family")
```

```{r nfl-figures, fig.width = 7.2, fig.height = 6}
                                       h$tier, h$rho, h$p_exact, h$q, h$p_within_stage)) +
      gs_theme() + ggplot2::theme(plot.title = ggplot2::element_text(size = FIG_BASE_PT, face = "bold"),
                                  plot.subtitle = ggplot2::element_text(size = FIG_MIN_PT))
  })
  f <- patchwork::wrap_plots(ps, ncol = 3, guides = "collect") +
    patchwork::plot_annotation(
      title = if (sup) "Donor set scores along serum NfL" else "Donor set scores along serum NfL (no supported result: exploratory shown)",
      caption = "Spearman, exact permutation over all donor orderings; within-stage p = NfL shuffled within stage only. Exploratory.",
      theme = ggplot2::theme(plot.title = ggplot2::element_text(size = FIG_BASE_PT, face = "bold"),
                             plot.caption = ggplot2::element_text(size = FIG_MIN_PT, hjust = 0))) &
    ggplot2::theme(legend.position = "bottom")
  print(f); nfl_save(f, "nfl_score_scatter", 25 + 55 * ceiling(nrow(pk) / 3))
}
```
